presentation.label: CHIMERA
presentation.summary: Your guitar as the voice of a simulated throat and mouth, like a talkbox: vowels, jaw, body size, nose, and a mouth that can follow your notes or babble.
presentation.overview: Your guitar as the voice of a simulated throat and mouth, like a talkbox: vowels, jaw, body size, nose, and a mouth that can follow your notes or babble.
highlights: Hold a harmonically rich sound and move the vowel controls to hear the formants.
usage: Add Chimera from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Hold a harmonically rich sound and move the vowel controls to hear the formants.
Use the page buttons to reach the remaining controls.

access.location: Delay group in the MS-70CDR effect list, under Chimera.
steps: Add Chimera from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Hold a harmonically rich sound and move the vowel controls to hear the formants.

controls.name: Vowel
controls.doc: params[5]. The mouth's shape: u, o, a, e, i from 0 to 100, morphing between. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Open
controls.doc: params[6]. Jaw and lips: closed (a hum, with Nasal) to wide open. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Body
controls.doc: params[7]. The throat's length: 19 cm (big) to 13.5 cm (small); 30 is an adult man. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Nasal
controls.doc: params[8]. Opens the soft palate into the nose. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Talk
controls.doc: params[9]. How far Move moves the mouth. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Move
controls.doc: params[10]. Named steps Pick, Slow, Fast, Chat: the mouth follows each note, sways slowly or quickly, or babbles. Range 0–3.

controls.name: Buzz
controls.doc: params[11]. Drives the guitar into a soft clipper first: more harmonics for the mouth to shape. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Breath
controls.doc: params[12]. Air noise through the throat, following your playing: a whisper. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.
